ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, flat broad leaves with visible pale midribs and stems, glossy and slightly wilted with a moist sheen, clustered in a mound covering roughly one-third of the plate's right side, leaves about 5-8 cm long, sitting directly on the white plate | 60

ITEM 2 | Thin matchstick-cut orange strips, about 4-6 cm long and roughly 0.3 cm wide, bright orange with a firm, slightly glossy surface, scattered in a small loose group in the center-left of the plate beside the greens | 5

ITEM 3 | Small pale yellow-white crumbs or bits, about 0.2-0.5 cm, dry and granular, scattered among the leaves and near the edge of the greens cluster | 2
